records.issue_text: app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/_topic-list.scss:115 — Defect (confidence 100, P2): `.topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification` still sets `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%);`, so a dark palette with white `$primary` renders category notification counts white instead of the secondary-derived muted color applied to sibling counts, leaving this explicitly targeted dark-theme conversion incomplete.
